intro: Built from wiki data: soft caps from two wikis, the infusion from the Infusion page, rings chosen by their effect text, and every weapon whose base scaling fits. Which rings make the list and the stat targets are the guide's own choice, read off those pages. The Creators box names an item only when two or more creators named it recently.

caps.t: Vigor levels 11 to 27 give 23 to 44 HP each; levels 28 to 49 give 5 to 19 HP; levels 50 to 99 give only 1 to 3 HP. The biggest gain in the wiki table, 44 HP per level, is at 16 and 17 Vigor.
FP per point is highest up to 35 Attunement, then drops. Slots come at 10, 14, 18 and more.
Stamina grows until 40 Endurance; past 40 you need 5 or more levels for each extra point.
Each level adds 1.0 to maximum equip load all the way to 99. Raise it only until your armor and weapons fit.
Damage per point drops after 40 and again after 60. Two-handing multiplies Strength by 1.5, so 27 reaches the 40 cap.

Both wikis put the first Dexterity soft cap at 40. The second Dexterity soft cap differs between them, 80 on the Dark Souls Wiki (as of the 1.32 regulation) and 60 on Fextralife. Casting speed stops improving at 50.

caps.cap: 40 (Fextralife) / minor cap 45, gains until 60 (Dark Souls Wiki); 30 for Dark or Chaos infusions
caps.t: Weapons with innate Magic damage and Crystal or Simple infusions soft-cap at 40 Intelligence. Weapons infused with a Chaos Gem or Dark Gem soft-cap at 30 Intelligence, along with 30 Faith. For staves the two wikis differ: Fextralife gives spell damage a soft cap at 40 and a sharper cap at 60; the Dark Souls Wiki says staves keep gaining until 60 Intelligence, with a minor soft cap at 45. Dark catalysts such as the [[Izalith Staff]] and [[Sunless Talisman]] improve up to 45 Intelligence and 45 Faith.

caps.cap: 40 for weapons; catalysts 40, 45 or 60 (Fextralife) / gains until 60, slower past 45 (Dark Souls Wiki); 30 for Dark or Chaos infusions
caps.t: Lightning weapons and weapons infused with a Lightning Gem or Blessed Gem soft-cap at 40 Faith. Infusions with a Chaos Gem or Dark Gem soft-cap at 30 Faith alongside 30 Intelligence. For miracle catalysts the two wikis differ: Fextralife gives a miracle soft cap of 40, 45 or 60 depending on the catalyst; the Dark Souls Wiki says talismans and chimes improve up until 60 Faith, and most fall off after 45 Faith. Dark catalysts use 45 Faith and 45 Intelligence.

caps.cap: 50 for bleed build-up (Fextralife); no damage soft cap given
caps.t: Luck raises item discovery and bleed build-up on regular and Blood-infused weapons. Fextralife says bleed build-up has its best gains between 25 and 50 Luck, where 50 is the hard cap. Hollow-infused weapons scale with Luck; neither wiki gives a soft cap for that damage.

idea.t: Big weapons, heavy hits that break an enemy's poise and stagger it. Two-hand to get the 1.5 Strength bonus.

stats.t: Vigor 27 first, Endurance toward 40, Strength 40, then Vigor toward 50.

infuse.t: Heavy raises Strength scaling and removes Dexterity scaling ([[Farron Coal]]).

idea.t: Fast weapons, katanas and curved swords; more hits per stamina bar.

stats.t: Vigor 27, Endurance toward 40, Dexterity 40, then Vigor toward 50.

infuse.t: Sharp raises Dexterity scaling and lowers Strength scaling ([[Farron Coal]]).

idea.t: Strength and Dexterity together. A Refined infusion equalizes a weapon's scaling with Strength and Dexterity.

stats.t: Vigor 27, Endurance toward 40, Strength 40 and Dexterity 40.

infuse.t: Refined evens out Strength and Dexterity scaling but lowers base damage more than Heavy or Sharp ([[Farron Coal]]).

idea.t: Ranged magic damage from a staff. Spells come from [[Orbeck of Vinheim]], [[Yoel of Londor]] and [[Karla]].

stats.t: Vigor 27, Attunement up to 35 for FP, Intelligence 40.

infuse.t: Crystal adds Magic damage and Intelligence scaling to your melee backup weapon ([[Sage's Coal]]).

idea.t: Lightning spears, heals and buffs. [[Irina of Carim]] sells miracles.

infuse.t: Blessed adds Faith scaling and slow HP recovery while held ([[Sage's Coal]]).

rings.e: Ring of the Sun's First Born

idea.t: Fire spells cast from a Pyromancy Flame; they use both Intelligence and Faith. [[Cornyx of the Great Swamp]] teaches them.

stats.t: Vigor 27, Attunement up to 35. Intelligence and Faith toward 40 each for the Pyromancy Flame. A Chaos-infused weapon soft-caps at 30 Intelligence and 30 Faith, so stop there if you fight with one.

infuse.t: Chaos adds Fire damage with Intelligence and Faith scaling, soft-capped at 30 in each ([[Giant's Coal]]).

idea.t: Dark damage from Intelligence and Faith together. Dark catalysts such as the [[Izalith Staff]] and [[Sunless Talisman]] improve up to 45 in both; weapons infused with a Dark Gem soft-cap at 30 in both.

stats.t: Vigor 27, Attunement up to 35. For a Dark-infused weapon, Intelligence 30 and Faith 30: the Dark Gem infusion soft-caps there. Go toward 45 Intelligence and 45 Faith only for a dark catalyst.

infuse.t: Dark adds Dark damage with Intelligence and Faith scaling, soft-capped at 30 in each ([[Profaned Coal]]).

idea.t: Fast weapons that build up bleed; Blood-infused weapons build bleed faster with Luck.

stats.t: Vigor 27, Endurance toward 40, the weapon's Dexterity or Strength requirement, then Luck.

infuse.t: Blood adds bleed build-up that scales with Luck ([[Profaned Coal]]).
